about: Watch models for the README table and the install pages' watch picker (tools/model_picker.py). status: tested (on a real watch), emulator (ran on its emulator image: tools/compat/sweep.mjs), untested (no usable emulator image; uses a package that ran on another model), unsupported. Compass and gyro come from specifications (the emulator feeds made-up sensor data on every model). Models marked tested or emulator needn't be checked again.
